title: Aloware Pricing in 2026: iPro, uPro and xPro Plans and Minimums
summary: Aloware is $30 (iPro), $60 (uPro) and $85 (xPro) per user a month billed annually, or $40, $70 and $100 monthly, with 5 to 10 user minimums. See add-ons.
body_markdown:
Aloware publishes prices for its three seat plans. Billed annually, iPro + AI is $30 per user a month, uPro + AI is $60 and xPro + AI is $85. Billed monthly, they are $40, $70 and $100. The plan cards state a minimum of 10 users on iPro and 5 on uPro and xPro. The Power Dialer starts at uPro. Two startup packages for up to 3 or 5 users are $199 and $399 per account a month. There is a 7-day free trial. The pages were read on November 18, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every Aloware detail below comes from Aloware's own pricing page, product pages, support center and terms, opened on November 18, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No Aloware account or trial was used and nothing was tested. Prices are in US dollars.


## Aloware pricing at a glance


Aloware's[pricing page](https://aloware.com/pricing) has three tabs: Human agents, AI agents and Startup plans. The Human agents tab has a switch between annual and monthly billing, and the annual view is labelled "Save 15%".


Aloware plans in US dollars, as listed on Aloware's own pricing page, read on November 18, 2026. The seat plans are priced per user a month. The startup packages are priced per account a month. Plan Billed annually Billed monthly Seat minimum Free trial What is included for calling


iPro + AI $30 per user $40 per user 10 users 7 days, no credit card Unlimited agent calls and one-to-one texts in the US and Canada, IVR, call recording, voicemail drops, HubSpot, Pipedrive and Zoho integrations. No Power Dialer


uPro + AI $60 per user $70 per user 5 users 7 days, no credit card iPro plus the Power Dialer, HubSpot workflows, call and text sequences, call coaching with listen and barge, and full API access


xPro + AI $85 per user $100 per user 5 users 7 days, no credit card uPro plus the Salesforce integration, AI agent monitoring, a 99.99% SLA and managed 10DLC compliance


3-user package Not shown $199 per account Up to 3 users 7 days uPro features with 500 minutes and 500 texts a month, up to 5 US local numbers and $25 of credits a month


5-user package Not shown $399 per account Up to 5 users 7 days uPro features with 2,500 minutes and 2,500 texts a month, up to 10 US local numbers and $100 of credits a month


The page says the trial is free for 7 days with no credit card required. Aloware's[sign-up guide](https://support.aloware.com/en/articles/9113024-aloware-self-sign-up-a-step-by-step-guide-to-getting-started) says a trial account is limited to 1,000 outbound calls. Its[terms](https://aloware.com/terms-and-conditions) say the account is not charged, and the subscription is suspended at the end of the trial until it is upgraded to a paid plan.


## What changes the real cost of Aloware


The seat price is public. The bill also depends on the user minimum, the billing term, phone numbers, automated usage and add-ons.


### User minimums


The iPro card says "Minimum 10 users". The uPro and xPro cards say "Minimum 5 users". On annual billing, that makes the smallest iPro bill $300 a month, the smallest uPro bill $300 and the smallest xPro bill $425. On monthly billing, they are $400, $350 and $500.


Aloware's[minimum license article](https://support.aloware.com/en/articles/10053441-understanding-the-minimum-license-count-in-aloware) says a customer agrees to buy and renew a minimum number of licenses when it signs a quote or contract. An account with fewer users than its minimum is still charged for the minimum.


One thing to confirm: Aloware's[billing article](https://support.aloware.com/en/articles/9033796-understanding-aloware-billing) works an example with 5 agents on iPro and 3 agents on uPro. The pricing cards say 10 and 5. Ask Aloware which minimum will be on your quote.


### Annual, quarterly or monthly terms


The billing article says each license has a term: monthly, quarterly or annual. The pricing page shows annual and monthly prices. It shows no quarterly price.


The same article says all licenses are non-refundable during their term and renew automatically for the next term. Aloware's[invoices article](https://support.aloware.com/en/articles/9867026-understanding-aloware-invoices) says subscriptions are prepaid, the billing cycle starts at the beginning of the month, and users added mid-month are prorated.


### What "unlimited" covers


The pricing page says agent-to-consumer and consumer-to-agent calls in the US and Canada are free on every seat plan, and so are one-to-one texts. Toll-free is excluded.


Automated usage is billed. That covers the SMS API, sequences, SMS broadcasts and calls or texts started from CRM workflows. The rates depend on the plan:


- **Outbound calls via automations:** 4 cents a minute on iPro, 3 cents on uPro and 2 cents on xPro.
- **Outbound SMS via automations:** 2 cents a segment on iPro, 1.5 cents on uPro and 1 cent on xPro.
- **Toll-free inbound calls:** 6, 5 or 4 cents a minute.
- **Carrier fees:** $0.005 to $0.015 a segment on every SMS or MMS, agent-sent or automated.


International calls and texts are billed at international rates, which the pricing page does not print. Usage is paid from prepaid credits. The invoices article says manual credit purchases start at $100, and the billing article says purchased credits are non-refundable.


### Phone numbers


Local and toll-free numbers are $6 a month each on iPro, $5 on uPro and $4 on xPro. Aloware's[add-ons article](https://support.aloware.com/en/articles/10053478-managing-add-ons-in-aloware) says numbers are billed per number, not per line.


### Add-ons


- **Local Presence:** $300 a month. It is an add-on on all three seat plans.
- **Branded Caller ID:** $0.12 a call on iPro, $0.10 on uPro and $0.09 on xPro.
- **Spam label removal:** an add-on on uPro and xPro. The price is not published.
- **Managed A2P 10DLC registration:** a $500 one-time fee.


Texting from local numbers needs A2P 10DLC registration. Aloware's[A2P fees article](https://support.aloware.com/en/articles/9032003-a2p-10dlc-fees-brand-registration-and-campaign-costs) lists a one-time brand fee of $47.50, a one-time $15 vetting fee for each campaign and $10 a month for each registered campaign.


### AI minutes and AI agents


Each seat plan includes AloAi Voice Analytics minutes: 1,000 on iPro, 5,000 on uPro and unlimited on xPro. The page says extra transcription minutes are not sold as an add-on. An account that runs out has to move to xPro.


The AI agents tab says the AloAi SMS Bot is free to enroll and the AloAi Voice Agent starts from 10 cents a minute. Aloware's separate[per-minute pricing page](https://aloware.com/ai-voice-agent/per-minute-pricing) gives $0.07 to $0.19 a minute, billed by the second with no minimum commitment. Its[outcome-based pricing page](https://aloware.com/ai-voice-agent/outcome-based-pricing) describes a price per result with a monthly floor. The starting rates differ, so ask for the rate in writing.


Aloware's terms say it may change prices at any time and that sales tax is added where required.


## Who Aloware fits and who it does not


Aloware describes itself as contact center software for sales and support teams. Every seat plan includes calling, texting, IVR, call recording and CRM integrations. The pricing page says it supports teams from 5 to 200 members.


That fits a team of five or more that calls and texts from HubSpot, Pipedrive or Zoho and wants agent calling without per-minute charges.


Aloware is a weaker fit for one or two users. The seat plans start at 5 or 10 users, and the startup packages cap minutes and texts. It is a weaker fit for a team that picks iPro for the price and then needs to dial lists, because the Power Dialer starts at uPro. A Salesforce team needs xPro, the only plan that lists the Salesforce integration.


It is also a weaker fit for a team that wants to call several numbers at once. Aloware's[dialer types article](https://support.aloware.com/en/articles/9037582-types-of-fast-dialing) says its power dialer calls leads one by one, and that Aloware will not provide a predictive dialer.

**Trellus** is a Chrome extension that adds power and parallel dialing inside the CRM, sales engagement platform or spreadsheet a team already uses. It works with 31 platforms. The[Trellus power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) plan, Power, is $99.99 per seat per month. The[Trellus parallel dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) plan, Power + Parallel, is $149.99 and calls up to five numbers at once. Both are bought online with no seat minimum. There is no free plan or free trial, and the Business plan is custom. The plan details are on[Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing) .


Aloware's list prices are lower than either Trellus plan and include a phone system with texting. Trellus costs more per seat, sells single seats and adds parallel dialing. Texting is not listed in its plans.


Some dialers quote instead: see[Kixie pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/post/kixie-pricing) . The wider field is in the guides to[Aloware alternatives](https://www.trellus.ai/post/aloware-alternatives) and[auto dialer software](https://www.trellus.ai/post/auto-dialer-software) .


## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Aloware cost per user?


Aloware's pricing page lists iPro + AI at $30 per user a month, uPro + AI at $60 and xPro + AI at $85, all billed annually. Billed monthly, they are $40, $70 and $100.


### What is the minimum number of Aloware users?


The plan cards say 10 users on iPro and 5 on uPro and xPro. That makes the smallest bill $300 a month on iPro or uPro with annual billing. The startup packages cover up to 3 users for $199 a month or up to 5 for $399.


### Does Aloware have a free trial?


Yes. The pricing page offers 7 days free with no credit card. Aloware's sign-up guide says a trial account is limited to 1,000 outbound calls.


### Which Aloware plan includes the Power Dialer?


uPro + AI and xPro + AI. The plan comparison table shows no Power Dialer on iPro. Aloware's support center says the dialer calls a list one contact at a time.


### Is calling really unlimited on Aloware?


For agents, yes, within limits the page states. Calls and one-to-one texts between agents and consumers in the US and Canada are free on the seat plans. Toll-free, international and automated calls and texts are billed by usage.


### What costs extra on Aloware?


Phone numbers are $4 to $6 a month each. Local Presence is $300 a month. Branded Caller ID is $0.09 to $0.12 a call. Automated calls are 2 to 4 cents a minute and automated texts 1 to 2 cents a segment, plus carrier fees.
